title: Three Hundred Years
summary: The farewell, played as drama. Oisin learns what three years in the Land of Youth has cost him, and Niamh gives him the horse and the warning anyway.

scenes.visual: Wide establishing shot of a high green headland above a calm sea at first light, one ancient wind-bent tree on the clifftop, a white horse standing saddled and waiting. No people in frame. Camera drifts slowly forward. Cold pale dawn light, mist on the water. Cinematic, photoreal, 35mm.
scenes.narration: Three years he had been happy

scenes.visual: Medium two-shot, the warrior and the golden-haired woman standing a little apart on the clifftop, both looking out to sea rather than at each other. Static camera. Pale dawn light. Cinematic, photoreal.

Close-up on the warrior's face in profile, static camera, very slow push-in. He speaks without turning, eyes on the horizon. Cold dawn light on one cheek. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.

dialogue.line: I still dream of my father.

scenes.visual: Close-up on the golden-haired woman, static camera. She does not speak. Her eyes move to him and away again. Pale light, faint gold aura. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.

Close-up on the golden-haired woman as she finally answers, static camera. Her expression is calm and terrible, as if saying something she has kept for years. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.

dialogue.line: Three years here. Three hundred there.

scenes.visual: Extreme close-up on the warrior's eyes as it lands, static camera. He does not move. Cold dawn light. Cinematic, photoreal, very shallow depth of field.
Close-up on the warrior, static camera, his jaw tightening as he speaks quietly. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.
Close-up on the golden-haired woman, static camera, a single small nod. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.
Medium two-shot, the warrior turning away from her toward the waiting horse, she remains still. Static camera. Cold pale light, sea beyond. Cinematic, photoreal.
Close-up on the warrior looking back at her, static camera, slow push-in. Grief and resolve together. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.

dialogue.line: I have to see it myself.

scenes.visual: Close-up on the golden-haired woman closing her eyes briefly, static camera. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.
Close-up on the golden-haired woman, static camera, very slow push-in as she gives permission she does not want to give. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.

dialogue.line: Then take Embarr. He knows the way.

scenes.visual: Medium two-shot, the golden-haired woman placing the reins of the white horse into the warrior's hands, their hands touching. Static camera. Pale dawn light. Cinematic, photoreal.
Close-up on the golden-haired woman, static camera, holding his gaze as she says the thing that matters. Utterly still. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.

dialogue.line: Never let your feet touch the ground.

scenes.visual: Close-up on the warrior mounted on the white horse looking down at her, static camera. He smiles slightly, certain of himself. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.

dialogue.line: I will come back to you.

scenes.visual: Close-up on the golden-haired woman, static camera. She says nothing at all. Her face does not move. Cinematic, photoreal, shallow depth of field.

Extreme wide shot of the clifftop, a lone rider on a white horse moving away along the headland, a single small figure left standing by the bent tree. Camera drifts slowly back and up. Pale dawn light, enormous sky. Cinematic, photoreal, 35mm, film grain.
scenes.narration: She let him go, and said nothing
